title: Anatomy legend
description: Every part of one component, as a tree, with its number on the drawing and its jobs. Drawn by the AnatomyLegend composite on a component's Anatomy reference.

parts.description: The component's top-level parts, in order.
Parts at one level of the tree.

n.description: The part's number on the drawing. Absent when the example does not show the part.

label.description: The part's name, such as Panel.

need.description: Whether the component always has the part.

note.description: A short note on the part, such as shown by Button.

noToken.description: The part has no token of its own yet.

byScheme.description: Whether the part's value changes by scheme.

roles.description: The design roles the part plays, such as Layering.
